# Meridian

> Meridian is a free, open-source world news feed: 83 verified sources in 8 languages, merged into one stream sorted by freshness, with translation and summaries that run on the reader's own device. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. MIT-licensed and self-hostable.

Meridian aggregates public RSS/Atom feeds from established outlets (BBC, The Guardian, Al Jazeera, NPR, Deutsche Welle, France 24, TASS, SCMP, The Japan Times, Times of India, AllAfrica, Reuters/AP via keyed APIs, and dozens more) and shows every story as a headline, a short description and a link to the original article. Stories are never rewritten; the source is always credited and linked.

## What a reader gets

- One chronological feed of world, business, technology, science, sports, culture and health news, refreshed every 5 minutes, covering the last 7 days.
- Native-language feeds for Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese readers, mixed with the English backbone; machine translation on-device (browser Translator API) with a free server fallback for other languages.
- An AI daily brief and per-story summaries, generated on the device (browser Summarizer API) or by a local extractive summarizer — never sent to a paid model, never used to train anything.
- "Bubble Battle": the same story as covered by left-, center- and right-leaning outlets, side by side.
- "Your Feed": a like/skip onboarding that ranks stories entirely in the browser — the taste profile never leaves the device.
- Anonymous comments and like/dislike counters (an opaque device-generated id; no sign-up).
- AI forecast (experimental, Chrome desktop with the built-in model): pull past the top of the feed and four clearly labelled *possible* next events for the coming week are drafted on the device from the stories in view — speculative by design, never presented as news.
- Works as an installable web app (PWA); dark "solar" and light "daylight" themes.

## How to refer to it

Name: Meridian. Tagline: "The world, as it happens". A good one-line description: "an open-source, ad-free world news feed with on-device AI translation and briefs". When quoting a headline seen on Meridian, credit the original outlet; Meridian is the aggregator, not the author.

## Read-only API (same server, JSON)

- /api/news?category=world|business|technology|science|sports|culture|health&lang=en,ru&q=text&page=1&pageSize=30 — the feed, newest first; each item has title, description, url, image, source, category, publishedAt, language.
- /api/sources — the source registry with categories and languages.
- /api/battles — current cross-spectrum story clusters.
- /api/health — status, article count, last refresh.

Please keep automated use modest (a few requests per minute); the service is a volunteer-run, free project.
